correctness.rationale: The positive weight has uniformly bounded edge ratios, so both coordinate backward shifts are bounded. At every fixed vertex a central binomial summand yields the full-sequence lower bound asymptotic to 2^{-i-j} sqrt(2n/pi). The continuous third-difference functional has coefficients of (1-z)^3(1+z)^n. Parseval/beta gives the exact squared-coefficient sum 120 C(2n,n)/[(n+1)(n+2)(n+3)], producing an O(n^{-1/4}) weighted dual norm on the central cone; the complementary cone is exponentially negligible via Hoeffding. Therefore the functional applied to every orbit converges to zero, preventing a dense orbit on all claimed spaces. Independently tested coefficient identity and numerical dual norm at n=16,64,256; this finite test is supplemental.
